name: meeting-transcribe-agent
description: Universal meeting intelligence and interactive verbatim transcription suite. Features native Multimodal Video Pipeline (YouTube URLs & local video files), Google Gemini 3.5 Transcribe (Cloud primary audio via Vertex AI), local Apple Silicon MLX/Whisper + Sherpa-ONNX diarization, Gemini 3.8 Flash minutes structuring, canonical speaker consolidation, and standalone zero-dependency interactive HTML playback player.
